title: 0.001 degrees apart. Watch them disagree.
description:
Two identical frictionless double pendulums, released together. One starts 0.001 degrees off; at arm's length that offset is about 12 micrometers, thinner than a hair. They overlap perfectly for 9.8 seconds, split, and by 14.9 seconds the gap is wider than the whole pendulum. They never agree again.

No randomness anywhere: the same equations, integrated exactly the same way (RK4, fixed step, energy drift under 1e-6). The divergence times in the narration were measured from this exact run at 110 degrees release angle. Rerun it and you get the same video.

This is chaos: determined, but not predictable.

Made end to end by an AI agent: simulation, footage, voice, music, and edit.
